common.savedThanks: Thanks. Every entry helps EmoLens learn.

fab.label: Log hard moment
fab.hint: Opens a quick log. You can save with one more tap.

welcome.title: EmoLens
welcome.tagline: Understand the patterns behind the hard moments.
welcome.forecastBody: See which times of day may be harder, with the reasons why.
welcome.understandBody: Find possible links to sleep, food, places and changes, with honest confidence.
welcome.shareBody: Bring clear summaries to teachers, therapists and doctors when you choose to.
welcome.notMedical: EmoLens is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition. It is built to support autistic children and the people who love them, not to change who they are.

who.title: Who's using EmoLens?
who.body1: EmoLens is used by adults who care for a child: parents, guardians and other caregivers.
who.body2: Your child doesn't use the app. You'll give them a nickname, and no photos are ever stored.
who.confirm: I am 18 or older and a parent, guardian, or caregiver

mode.title: Where should your data live?
mode.subtitle: You can change this later.
mode.localBody: Private and encrypted. Nothing leaves this phone.
mode.accountBody: Adds Care Team sharing and clinician reports. Sign in with a code sent to your email.
mode.accountExplain: We'll email you a 6-digit code. No password needed. Accounts are for adults (18+).
mode.joinBody: Someone invited you with a code (a parent, for a caregiver, teacher or clinician).

child.title: About your child
child.subtitle: Just the basics. Only the nickname is needed.
child.nicknameHint: What EmoLens will call your child. A first name or nickname is fine.
child.birthYearHint: Only the year, never a full birth date.
child.wakeHint: EmoLens only looks at the hours your child is usually awake.
child.sleepHoursHint: About how many hours a night?
child.timeZoneHint: Detected from this phone. Change it only if your child lives in another time zone.
child.deviceSubtitle: Collecting place arrivals and health data for {{name}}.
child.batteryIos: Leave Background App Refresh on for EmoLens (Settings → General → Background App Refresh).
child.batteryAndroid: Set EmoLens battery use to "Unrestricted" (Settings → Apps → EmoLens → Battery).
child.lowPower: Low Power Mode is on, which pauses background updates.
child.careTeamOff: Care Team is off on this device. What it collects stays here.

frequency.title: How often do hard moments happen for {{name}}?
frequency.subtitle: A rough guess is perfect. It's only a starting point.
frequency.note: EmoLens replaces this guess with your real logs as they come in.

types.title: Which hard moments do you want to track?
types.subtitle: Pick the ones that fit your child.

desc.meltdown: An outward release when things become too much: crying, yelling, dropping, moving.
desc.shutdown: An inward response to overwhelm: going quiet, withdrawing, not responding.
desc.other: Other signs of distress that matter to you.

episode.title: Log a hard moment
episode.saveFastHint: You can add details when things are calm.
episode.savedFast: Saved. You can add details any time.
episode.safety: Someone was hurt or at risk
episode.safetyBody: If anyone is in immediate danger, call 911. For ongoing safety concerns, contact your child's care team.
episode.noPhotos: EmoLens never stores photos of your child.

triggers.title: What do you think sets things off?
triggers.subtitle: Pick any that you suspect.
triggers.note: EmoLens will check these against real data. It's fine to guess.

helps.title: What helps?
helps.subtitle: Pick the calming strategies that often help. You can add your own.

meds.stepSubtitle: Optional. Add any regular or as-needed medications.
meds.privacyNote: Medication names stay on this phone and never appear in notification text.
meds.name: Name
meds.nameHint: Type the name as it appears on the label.
meds.asNeededHint: No fixed schedule; log each dose when it's given.
meds.remindersHint: A reminder at each time, with Given and Skip buttons. Medication names never show on the lock screen.
meds.prescriberNote: EmoLens never suggests medication changes. Please talk with your child's prescriber about any change.
meds.emptyBody: Add medications to track doses and spot possible links.
meds.confirmStop: Tap again to stop it today
meds.fromRxNorm: Name from RxNorm, the U.S. medication list.
meds.searchOffline: Name search needs an internet connection. Any name you type works.
meds.reminderBlocked: Saved, but reminders can't appear: notifications are off for EmoLens in Settings.

places.title: Places
places.subtitle: Tag the places your child spends time. It helps EmoLens notice patterns around places and arrivals.
places.label: Name
places.privacy: Map locations never leave this phone. Only place names and kinds are ever shared, and only if you turn on Care Team.
places.whoseTitle: Whose phone tracks where your child is?

whose.my_phoneBody: I'm usually with them, so my location counts as theirs.
whose.child_device: A phone or tablet my child carries
whose.child_deviceBody: Install EmoLens on it and choose Child device in More → Device role.
whose.manualBody: Check in with one tap when your child arrives somewhere.

places.checkInNote: With location on ("Always"), arrivals at places with a map location are noticed automatically.
places.emptyBody: Tag home, school and other places your child spends time.
places.locationDenied: Location wasn't allowed. You can type an address instead.
places.locationFailed: Couldn't get the location. Please try again.
places.homeLocationBody: Used for weather near home and to notice arrivals. The weather service gets only a rounded location (about 1 km); the exact spot never leaves this phone.
places.mapHint: Lets EmoLens notice arrivals here. The location is saved only on this phone.
places.searchLabel: Search for an address or place
places.searchNone: No matches. Try adding the street or town.
places.searchOffline: Search isn't available right now. Check your connection, press Return to look up the address on this phone, or use your current location.
places.searchNote: What you type in the search box is sent to Photon, an OpenStreetMap search service, to find matches (with your rough area, about 1 km, once Home is set). The place you pick is saved only on this phone.

connect.title: Connect data
connect.subtitle: Each one is optional. EmoLens explains what it uses before your phone asks.
connect.notificationsBody: Gentle reminders to add details, and heads-ups before harder times.
connect.healthBody: Sleep, heart rate and steps from your child's own device or watch.
connect.calendarBody: Notices transitions, appointments and unusual days. Event titles stay on this phone.
connect.locationBody: Notices arrivals at tagged places. Coordinates never leave this phone.
connect.microphoneBody: Measures how loud a room is. Sound is never recorded or stored.
connect.deniedLater: Not allowed. You can turn it on later in More → Data sources.
connect.locationAlways: Notices when your child arrives at a tagged place. Choose "Always" so it works in the background; "While Using" works too, with check-ins by hand. Coordinates never leave this phone.

alertsStep.title: Alerts
alertsStep.subtitle: Once EmoLens has learned enough, it can give you a heads-up before harder times.

example.fewer: Only the clearest higher-chance times. Fewer interruptions.
example.balanced: A heads-up when the chance is about twice the usual. A good place to start.
example.more: Earlier and more often. Helpful if you want to plan ahead a lot.

alertsStep.eodHint: A one-tap check-in about how the day went.

reveal.title: Your starting profile
reveal.m1Body: Log hard moments and a few everyday things. EmoLens starts learning right away.
reveal.m2Body: Patterns appear only when the evidence is there, and EmoLens is honest about how sure it is.
reveal.m3Body: Forecasts get sharper with every day of data.

today.learningBanner: EmoLens is learning {{name}}'s patterns: day {{day}} of about {{total}}
today.learningAlmost: EmoLens is still learning {{name}}'s patterns. Forecasts start as soon as there's enough data.
today.noAwakeBlocks: No awake hours set for today.
today.learningNow: EmoLens is still learning {{name}}'s patterns, so there's no forecast yet. Every entry helps it learn.
today.tryingSaved: Noted: {{name}}. EmoLens will check how it went.
today.detailsBody: {{time}} · Add them when things are calm.
today.learningDays: EmoLens is learning {{name}}'s patterns: {{day}} of about {{total}} days with answers
today.confirmBody: EmoLens sent a heads-up for this time. Your answer helps it learn.
today.answerSaved: Thanks. EmoLens is updating its forecast.
today.followupBody: You stepped in early for {{range}}. Pick what you tried, so EmoLens learns what works. (Optional)
today.followupSaved: Noted. Stepping in early is a win.
today.eodBody: One tap if nothing else happened.
today.yesterdayBody: It takes a few seconds and makes forecasts sharper.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.swipeHint: Swipe left or right to change the day.
timeline.emptyBody: Use the button below or Quick add on Today. Every entry helps.
timeline.swipeTip: Tap to edit · swipe left to delete

outcome.pending: Before a hard moment · checking how it went

meal.title: Meal or drink
meal.itemsHint: Tap recent items, or add new ones.
meal.searchPlaceholder: Type a food, e.g. apple slices
meal.searchOffline: Food search needs an internet connection. You can still type any food.
meal.sourcesNote: Food details come from Open Food Facts and USDA FoodData Central.

sleep.title: How did {{name}} sleep?
sleep.invalid: Wake-up needs to be after bedtime.

illness.title: Illness or discomfort
illness.ongoingHint: Shows on Today until you mark it better.
illness.saved: Saved. Hope they feel better soon.

strategy.title: Calming strategy
strategy.intro: Trying something to help before things get hard? Log it, and EmoLens will learn what works.
strategy.saved: Noted. EmoLens will check how it went.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: What EmoLens is learning about {{name}}
insights.learning: EmoLens is gathering {{name}}'s data. Insights appear only when the evidence is there, never before.
insights.patternsEmpty: Patterns appear after about two weeks of logging.
insights.patternsEmptyBody: Each one will show how confident EmoLens is, and how it knows.
insights.toTestBody: You suspected these. EmoLens will check them against real data.
insights.whatHelpsBody: Which calming strategies help most, before and during hard moments.
insights.timeOfDayBody: When hard moments tend to happen, with honest uncertainty.
insights.modelHealthBody: How EmoLens's forecasts compare with a simple time-of-day guess.
insights.learningProgress: {{days}} of {{total}} days with answers · {{pos}} of 3 hard moments
insights.patternsSub: Strongest first. Tap one to see how EmoLens knows.
insights.howSure: How precisely the size is known: {{pct}}
insights.notTrackedBody: EmoLens can check these once their data source is on and has enough data.
insights.yourIdeas: Your ideas, checked against the data
insights.worthSub: Specific foods, medicines, places or schedule events that stood out. Patterns aren't proof.
insights.todSub: How often a hard moment happened in each 2-hour block (with answers), with honest uncertainty.
insights.todSummary: Hard moments by time of day: most common {{range}}.
insights.todEmpty: This chart fills in as you answer and log.
insights.healthBetter: {{pct}} better than a simple time-of-day guess
insights.healthNotYet: Not yet better than a time-of-day guess; still learning
insights.healthWaiting: Appears after about 3 weeks of logging
insights.meterCaption: How precisely the size is known
insights.seenIn_one: Seen in {{count}} time block so far
insights.seenIn_other: Seen in {{count}} time blocks so far
insights.askOff: Turn on AI features to ask questions about {{name}}'s patterns.

team.title: Team
team.localBody: Right now EmoLens keeps all of your child's data private on this phone. With an account, you'll be able to invite your child's care team and choose exactly what each person can see.
team.createAccount: Create account to invite your team
team.whoTitle: Who you'll be able to invite

roles.caregiverBody: Another parent, a grandparent or a sitter can log and see patterns.
roles.teacherBody: Can log hard moments at school and see today's school-hours outlook. Never medications or home places.
roles.clinicianBody: Therapists and doctors can view summaries and write notes, but not change your logs.

team.demoNote: Care Team isn't available in demo mode: demo data never leaves the phone.
team.turnOnBody: Turn on Care Team to invite other caregivers, teachers and clinicians. Each person sees only what their role allows.
team.syncsList: Hard moments, strategies and what helped, medications and doses, meals, sleep, illness, notes, routine changes, place names and visits, heads-ups and your end-of-day checks.
team.neverList: Place locations (map coordinates), calendar event titles, heart-rate readings, sound checks, weather and the model's raw numbers.
team.turnOnConfirmBody: {{name}}'s history is uploaded to EmoLens's secure server so your team can see it. You can delete it anytime by deleting your account.
team.turnedOn: Care Team is on. Invite your team below.
team.removeBody: They lose access right away, and their phone deletes its copy of the data.
team.removeFailed: Couldn't remove them. Check the internet connection and try again.
team.yourNameHint: What your team sees next to your entries, like "Ms. Lopez" or "Dad".
team.nameFailed: Couldn't save your name. Check the internet connection and try again.
team.activityEmpty: Entries from the rest of the team will appear here.

sync.removed: No longer on this care team
sync.signedOut: Signed out: sign in again to sync
sync.errorBanner: EmoLens couldn't sync for a while. Your entries are safe on this phone and will sync when it can. Tap Sync now to try again.

more.title: More
more.demoSub: Try EmoLens with a pretend child
more.reportsSub: PDF report, ABC data, health record
more.accountSub: Sign in to share with your care team
more.aiSub: Ask EmoLens, voice notes, AI summaries

settings.howOften: How often hard moments happen (starting guess)
settings.schoolDaysHint: Used to compare school days with other days.
settings.alertsNote: Alerts start after the learning period. These choices are saved now so they're ready.
settings.earlyAlertsHint: Get heads-ups before the first two weeks are done. They may be less accurate.
settings.morningOutlookHint: One short summary of the day each morning.
settings.p1: Everything is stored on this phone in an encrypted database. The key is kept in the phone's secure storage.
settings.p2: No ads, no tracking, no analytics.
settings.p3: Exact place locations are saved only on this phone. The weather service gets a rounded location (about 1 km), and place searches send what you type to an OpenStreetMap search service. Calendar titles stay here unless you let the AI see them.
settings.p4: Nothing is shared unless you turn on Care Team or AI features.
settings.appLockHint: Ask for Face ID, fingerprint or your passcode when opening EmoLens.
settings.lockUnavailable: App lock needs Face ID, fingerprint or a passcode set up on this phone.
settings.deleteBody: This permanently deletes everything EmoLens has stored on this phone (the real profile and the demo) and its encryption key. It can't be undone.
settings.deleteBodyDemo: You're in demo mode. This still deletes everything EmoLens has stored on this phone, including the real profile. It can't be undone.
settings.languageNote: Strategy names you already saved keep their original language.
settings.roleCaregiverBody: The full app: logging, Timeline, Insights.
settings.roleChildBody: Runs quietly on a phone or tablet your child carries, sharing place arrivals and health data with your Care Team.
settings.roleNote: A child device shows only a simple status screen.
settings.disclaimer2: Patterns are possible links, not proof. Please talk with your child's care team before making changes.
settings.disclaimer3: If anyone is in immediate danger, call 911.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Technical errors only. These never include your child's information.
settings.roleChildConfirm: Use this phone as a child device
settings.receiveAlertsBody: Notifications before times with a higher chance of a hard moment, and "How did it go?" afterwards.
settings.primaryForecasterBody: Creates the heads-ups the team gets and shares the day's patterns with clinicians. Keep this on for one phone only, usually the parent's with the most data sources.

how.s1Body: One tap for a hard moment on the worst day. Add details later if you want to.
how.s3Body: After about two weeks, EmoLens shows which times may be harder and why, with an honest range.
how.s4Body: Your data is encrypted on this phone. It only leaves if you choose Care Team or AI features.

demo.banner: DEMO DATA: not a real child
demo.title: Demo mode
demo.body1: Demo mode opens a separate pretend profile so you can try every screen. Your real profile stays untouched.
demo.body2: It is filled with about 120 days of a simulated family, run through the same forecasting engine as your real data. The first time takes a minute.
demo.exitBody: Go back to your real profile. The demo stays saved for next time.
demo.stale: The simulated days end on {{date}}. Regenerate to bring them up to today.
demo.regenerateConfirm: Replace the demo data with a fresh simulation that ends today? Anything you logged in the demo is removed. Your real profile is not touched.
demo.toolsBody: Only in demo mode. Try the heads-up and answer loop without waiting.
demo.sendAlertDone: Heads-up in 5 seconds; "How did it go?" in 1 minute.
demo.sendAlertNoNotif: Notifications are off, so open the answer card on Today instead.
demo.askPastDone: Added a "How did it go?" card on Today.
demo.askPastNone: Every earlier time today already has an answer.
demo.buildingBody: EmoLens is living through {{days}} simulated days of a made-up family, refitting the same engine every evening.
demo.buildingNote: This happens once. Next time demo mode opens instantly.
demo.buildFailed: The demo couldn't be built. Please try again.
demo.buildTime: Built on this phone in {{s}} s.

lock.title: EmoLens is locked
lock.body: Unlock to see your child's information.

notif.detailsBody: When things are calm, add a few details about the hard moment at {{time}}?
notif.medBody: A scheduled dose is due. Tap Given or Skip.
notif.riskBody: Higher chance of a hard moment for {{name}}. Main reasons: {{reasons}}. Tap for ideas that have helped.
notif.riskBodyNoReasons: Higher chance of a hard moment for {{name}}. Tap for ideas that have helped.
notif.confirmBody: Tap an answer. Every answer helps EmoLens learn.
notif.outlookHigh: Today's outlook for {{name}}: mostly calm; higher chance {{ranges}}.
notif.outlookModerate: Today's outlook for {{name}}: mostly calm; a bit higher chance {{ranges}}.
notif.patternBody: EmoLens found a likely pattern: {{factor}}. Tap to see how it knows.

errors.crashBody: Sorry about that. Your data is safe. Try again, and if it keeps happening, copy the details for help.
errors.migrationBody: Your data is safe and nothing was deleted. Please try again.
errors.openBody: Your data has not been deleted. Please try again.
errors.saveFailed: That didn't save. Please try again.

sources.subtitle: What EmoLens reads automatically. Everything is optional and stays on this phone.
sources.weatherBody: Temperature, pressure changes, air quality and pollen near home, from Open-Meteo. Only a rounded location (about 1 km) is sent.
sources.healthBody: Sleep, heart rate, heart-rate variability and steps. Raw readings never leave this phone.
sources.locationBody: Notices arrivals at the places you tagged (needs "Always" location). Coordinates never leave this phone.
sources.locationNoPlaces: Add a map location to a place
sources.locationWhileUsing: Allowed only while using the app
sources.soundOnEpisode: Measure room sound for 60 seconds when I log a hard moment
sources.healthWhose: Health data comes from this phone. Your own phone's data describes you, not your child; your child's phone or watch (Child device mode) is the right source.
sources.whileUsingExplain: With "While Using" only, EmoLens can't notice arrivals in the background. Check in with one tap instead (Today → Place), or change it to "Always" in Settings.
sources.healthNoData: EmoLens asked Apple Health for sleep, heart rate and steps but received nothing. Either there's no data yet, or access is turned off: open Settings → Health → Data Access & Devices → EmoLens and turn on the categories.
sources.noDataHint: Nothing was received. Check this source's permission in Settings.
sources.nothingNew: Up to date. Nothing new to import.

notice.geofencing_unavailable: This device can't watch places in the background, so arrivals aren't noticed automatically. Check in by hand: Today → Place.

noticeSync.geofencing_unavailable: Location: this device can't watch places in the background. Check in by hand with Today → Place.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.subtitle: Choose what EmoLens reads to notice transitions, appointments and unusual days.
calendars.none: No calendars found on this phone
calendars.privacy: Event titles stay on this phone. Only tags like "appointment" are used for patterns.
calendars.keywordsBody: EmoLens tags events by words in their titles ("dentist" → appointment). Add words your family uses.
calendars.eventsSubtitle: The last week and next two weeks. Tap an event to change its tags or ignore it.
calendars.ignoreHint: EmoLens won't use it for patterns.
calendars.noEventsBody: Choose calendars in Data sources, then pull down to refresh.
calendars.noAccessBody: Calendar access is off. EmoLens needs "Full Access" to read your events (titles stay on this phone). Turn it on in Settings → EmoLens → Calendars.
calendars.loadFailedBody: Something went wrong while reading the calendar list. Please try again.

scan.title: Scan a barcode
scan.permissionBody: EmoLens uses the camera only to read the barcode. No photos are saved.
scan.hint: Point the camera at the barcode on the package.
scan.offline: Couldn't look it up. Check your internet connection.

sound.title: Sound check
sound.saved: Saved. Only this number is kept.
sound.failed: The sound check didn't work. Please try again.
sound.stopped: The sound check stopped because EmoLens went to the background. Nothing was saved.
sound.privacy: Nothing is recorded or kept: EmoLens measures loudness only, then throws the audio away.
sound.estimate: Estimated loudness. Phone microphones differ, so treat it as a rough guide.
sound.onEpisode: Measuring room sound for 60 seconds (nothing is recorded).

forecast.estimatedNote: Some inputs are expected, not measured yet.
forecast.learningNote: EmoLens is still learning {{name}}'s patterns, so this is mostly a starting estimate.
forecast.unavailable: Forecast temporarily unavailable. EmoLens is showing its last good forecast.
forecast.none: No forecast yet. It appears after EmoLens runs for the first time.
forecast.outlookModerate: Mostly calm today; a bit higher chance {{ranges}}.

block.title: {{range}} · {{day}}
block.noForecast: No forecast was saved for this time.

confirm.title: How did {{range}} go?
confirm.subtitle: {{day}}. Pick the answer that fits best.
confirm.happenedSub: EmoLens saves it now; add details later if you like.
confirm.steppedInSub: You saw it coming and helped. EmoLens won't count this against its forecast.
confirm.calmSub: No hard moment in this time.
confirm.current: Your answer: {{answer}}. You can change it.
confirm.why: Why three answers? If you step in and things stay calm, that's success, not a wrong forecast. Keeping it separate stops EmoLens from learning the wrong lesson.

eod.title: How was {{day}}?
eod.question: Were there any other hard moments that aren't logged?
eod.savedAll: Thanks. {{name}}'s calm times help EmoLens learn too.
eod.savedUnsure: Thanks. Unsure times are simply left out.

trigger.howSureTitle: How precisely EmoLens knows the size of this effect
trigger.howSureBody: {{pct}} of EmoLens's starting uncertainty about the size of this effect has been cleared up by {{name}}'s own data. It fills in slowly: a link can be clear long before its exact size is.
trigger.notEnough: EmoLens needs more days with this (and without it) before it can say anything.
trigger.chart1: Hard moments with vs without it
trigger.chart1Sub: Share of time blocks with a hard moment. Lines show the likely range.
trigger.chart1Summary: Hard moments in {{a}} of blocks with it, {{b}} without it.
trigger.chart2Sub: Each week's estimate with its likely range. 1× means no link.
trigger.chart2Empty: This chart starts after the first weekly estimate.
trigger.oddsNote: These numbers are odds ratios. When hard moments happen in a minority of time blocks, they're close to "times the chance".
trigger.prescriber: Consider discussing this with your child's prescriber.
trigger.hidden: Not tracked: turn on its data source to check this.
trigger.meterMeaning: The meter shows how pinned-down the exact size is.

statusMeaning.strong: “{{status}}” = EmoLens is confident this raises the chance.
statusMeaning.likely: “{{status}}” = EmoLens is fairly confident this raises the chance.
statusMeaning.possible: “{{status}}” = the data leans toward this raising the chance, but EmoLens isn't confident yet.
statusMeaning.protective: “{{status}}” = EmoLens is fairly confident this lowers the chance.
statusMeaning.no_clear_link: “{{status}}” = if this changes the chance at all, the change is small.
statusMeaning.checking: “{{status}}” = the data doesn't point clearly either way yet.
statusMeaning.not_enough_data: “{{status}}” = EmoLens needs more days with and without this before it can say anything.

trigger.evidenceWith_one: {{k}} of {{count}} time block with it had a hard moment.
trigger.evidenceWith_other: {{k}} of {{count}} time blocks with it had a hard moment.
trigger.evidenceWithout_one: Compared with {{k}} of {{count}} time block without it.
trigger.evidenceWithout_other: Compared with {{k}} of {{count}} time blocks without it.

watch.place_other: Hard moments were more common while at {{item}} (about {{n}}×, based on {{count}} time blocks).

watch.calendar_tag_other: Hard moments were more common around calendar events tagged {{item}} (about {{n}}×, based on {{count}} time blocks).

strategies.title: What helps
strategies.subtitle: Calming strategies and how often each one helped.
strategies.discoverSub: Sometimes suggests strategies you haven't tried much, so EmoLens can learn about them too.
strategies.barLabel: Estimated {{mean}} chance it helps, likely between {{lo}} and {{hi}}
strategies.caveat: Calm afterward isn't proof the strategy did it, but it's a good sign.

strategies.emptyBefore: No strategies tried before hard moments yet. Use "We're trying this" on Today.

health.title: Forecast accuracy
health.subtitle: How EmoLens's evening-before forecasts compared with what really happened.
health.better: EmoLens forecasts are {{pct}} better than a simple time-of-day guess
health.notYet: Not yet better than a simple time-of-day guess; still learning
health.waiting: Model health appears after about 3 weeks of logging.

health.alertsHit: When you answered, a hard moment happened after {{pct}} of heads-ups.
health.alertsSummary: Heads-ups: {{delivered}}. A hard moment: {{happened}}. Stepped in: {{stepped}}. Calm: {{calm}}. Not answered: {{none}}.

report.disclaimer: Caregiver-reported observations and statistical patterns. Not a diagnosis.
report.trend: Compared with the period before of the same length: {{change}} ({{prev}} then).
report.mostLikely: Hard moments were most likely in the {{when}} block (see the time-of-day chart).

report.timeOfDayTitle: Share of time blocks with a hard moment, by time of day

gloss.status: Status: “Strong link”, “Likely link” and “Possible link” say how sure EmoLens is that a factor raises the chance of a hard moment. “No clear link” means enough data showed no real difference.
gloss.odds: Effect (odds ratio): “2.0×” means about twice the usual chance of a hard moment when the factor is there; “0.7×” means about 30% lower. 1× means no difference.
gloss.range: Likely range (80%): EmoLens is 80% sure the true effect is between these two numbers. A narrow range means it is well known.
gloss.confidence: How precisely known: how much of EmoLens's starting uncertainty about the size of an effect {{name}}'s own data has cleared up.
gloss.blocks: Time blocks: EmoLens looks at the day in 2-hour blocks. A block counts once a hard moment was logged in it or the caregiver said it was calm.

disclosure.builtTitle: How AI was used during development
disclosure.built1: I wrote the code for EmoLens. I used AI tools to help investigate errors and debug problems.
disclosure.built2: I reviewed and applied fixes myself. See AIDisclosure.md in the project repository for the full disclosure.
disclosure.inApp1: The optional AI features (Ask EmoLens, turning voice and school notes into entries, and the weekly summary) use Anthropic's Claude. They stay off until you turn them on in More → AI features, which lists exactly what is sent.
disclosure.inApp2: Patterns and forecasts don't come from the AI features. They come from a statistics model that runs on this phone.
